text: National Institute of Technology Srinagar (NIT Srinagar or NITSRI) is a public technical university situated in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India. It is one of the 31 National Institutes of Technology (NITs) and operates directly under the Ministry of Education (MoE). Established in 1960 as the Regional Engineering College, Srinagar, it was one of the first eight Regional Engineering Colleges set up by the Government of India during the first Five-Year Plan. The institute shifted to its current campus in 1965 and was upgraded to National Institute of Technology, Srinagar, in July 2003. It was granted Deemed University status in the same year by the University Grants Commission, All India Council of Technical Education, and the Government of India. On 15 August 2007, it became an Institute of National Importance under the NIT Bill passed by the Indian Parliament. NIT Srinagar is governed by the National Institutes of Technology Act, 2007. It admits undergraduate students through the Joint Entrance Examination (Main) (JEE-Main) or Direct Admission of Students Abroad (DASA) for non-resident Indians via SAT. Postgraduate admissions are based on GATE scores through Centralized Counselling for M.Tech. (CCMT) and via the Joint Admission Test for M.Sc. for M.Sc. programs. The institute has 12 academic departments covering Engineering, Applied Sciences, Humanities, and Social Sciences, with English as the medium of instruction. It includes eight engineering departments—Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, and Information Technology—and four Physical Sciences departments—Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Humanities. Prof. Binod Kumar Kanuajia serves as the director of NIT Srinagar and is recognized for his contributions to education and leadership in advancing educational and research initiatives. The campus is located on the western bank of Dal Lake near the Hazratbal Shrine in the northeastern part of Srinagar city, 23 km from the Srinagar International Airport and 13 km from Srinagar railway station. NIT Srinagar is ranked 79th among engineering colleges in India by the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) in 2024 and holds the 24th rank among the best engineering colleges in India according to India Today's Annual Rankings 2022. The campus features academic buildings, student hostels for non-locals, and far-flung areas of the valley; however, there are no residential facilities for PhD scholars. The Health Centre provides medical care to students, teachers, staff, and their families. The Central Library is automated, operates seven days a week, serves over 3,500 users from 12 departments and centers, and holds 75,000 books. The campus has a fiber optic and Wi-Fi network covering all departments, teacher quarters, and student hostels, along with a central computer lab and departmental computer labs. It is also part of the high-speed National Knowledge Network. Separate hostels are provided for male and female students, each with its own mess, and guesthouses are available for temporary accommodation. For the first three years of B.Tech., each hostel room is shared by five students; in the fourth year, students are allotted single rooms in the Jhelum hostel based on CGPA (up to the 5th semester). Students unable to secure a single room in Jhelum are assigned to Dal hostels, where rooms are shared by two students. M.Tech students and PhD scholars are accommodated in the Tawi hostel, where each room is shared by three students. A Common Hall adjacent to the hostels offers indoor games such as table tennis and carom, along with a gymnasium. The institute has a Maintenance Engineering Centre established through an Indo-Italian collaboration that supports research, consultancy, and academic activities in maintenance engineering for the institute and the region. Techvaganza, a national-level technical festival (Tech-Fest), is held annually in April at NIT Srinagar and is the first techno-management festival in the region.
